presentation.description: Create presets of automatic reactions that run when a specific or any nearby player enters range or performs an emote. Choose the response command, timing, cooldown, distance, weather, targeting, and optional nameplate glow; COPYCAT can mirror incoming emotes, and advanced rules can launch local media. Use /hfh or the guided setup wizard to configure.
